I am 70 years old and retired in Bangkok and I recently suffered a chip on one of my lower front teeth. As it was not painful I was debating perhaps not visiting a dentist but my sense of caution outweighed my lackadaisical tendencies
NEOSMILE is on my daily walking circuit so I walked in yesterday afternoon and made an  appointment for this morning at 11:30   I arrived at 11:00AM  and was in the dentist’s chair by 11:15. The actual office is quite old and perhaps off-putting but Dr Chongcharoenjai is a master of his craft and after an x-ray confirmed  a deep cavity he gave me two options which were entirely my choice :  he could remove the cavity and repair the tooth or I could have a root canal to prevent any possible future pain.  I opted for just the filling understanding the possible future ramifications and the procedure lasted 45 minutes
The office staff are both kind , professional and fluent in English and the total cost including x-ray,  pain killer and  the good dentist’s time was 2,650 Baht which is a very economic price.  I will gladly return for any future dental issues as it was a highly satisfactory experience in all regards.
